mapper.select: SELECT po.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, NULL AS goodsId, NULL AS goodsCode, NULL AS goodsName, NULL AS categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT po.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity), 0) AS purchaseQty, COALESCE(SUM(poi.amount), 0) AS purchaseAmount, COALESCE(SUM(poi.received_qty), 0) AS receivedQty, (COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(poi.received_qty), 0)) AS inTransitQty, COALESCE(MAX(r.returnQty), 0) AS returnQty, COALESCE(MAX(r.returnAmount), 0) AS returnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.settle_status = 'SETTLED' THEN poi.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settledAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.settle_status = 'PARTIAL' THEN poi.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partialSettledAmount, NULL AS shareRate FROM purchase_order po JOIN supplier s ON s.id = po.supplier_id JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pt.supplier_id AS sid, SUM(pri.return_qty) AS returnQty, SUM(pri.amount) AS returnAmount FROM purchase_return_order pt JOIN purchase_return_item pri ON pri.return_id = pt.id WHERE pt.status = 'APPROVED' AND pt.create_time >= #{beginTime} AND pt.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY pt.supplier_id) r ON r.sid = po.supplier_id WHERE po.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') AND po.create_time >= #{beginTime} AND po.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY po.supplier_id, s.name, r.returnQty, r.returnAmount ORDER BY purchaseAmount DESC

SELECT NULL AS supplierId, NULL AS supplierName, poi.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.name AS goodsName, c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT po.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity), 0) AS purchaseQty, COALESCE(SUM(poi.amount), 0) AS purchaseAmount, COALESCE(SUM(poi.received_qty), 0) AS receivedQty, (COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantity), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(poi.received_qty), 0)) AS inTransitQty, COALESCE(MAX(r.returnQty), 0) AS returnQty, COALESCE(MAX(r.returnAmount), 0) AS returnAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.settle_status = 'SETTLED' THEN poi.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settledAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.settle_status = 'PARTIAL' THEN poi.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partialSettledAmount, NULL AS shareRate FROM purchase_order po JOIN purchase_order_item poi ON poi.order_id = po.id JOIN goods g ON g.id = poi.goods_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pri.goods_id AS gid, SUM(pri.return_qty) AS returnQty, SUM(pri.amount) AS returnAmount FROM purchase_return_order pt JOIN purchase_return_item pri ON pri.return_id = pt.id WHERE pt.status = 'APPROVED' AND pt.create_time >= #{beginTime} AND pt.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY pri.goods_id) r ON r.gid = poi.goods_id WHERE po.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') AND po.create_time >= #{beginTime} AND po.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY poi.goods_id, g.goods_code, g.name, c.name, r.returnQty, r.returnAmount ORDER BY purchaseAmount DESC

SELECT po.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, COUNT(*) AS receiptCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ro.receipt_time) <= po.expect_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onTimeCount, NULL AS onTimeRate FROM receipt_order ro JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = ro.purchase_order_id JOIN supplier s ON s.id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.expect_date IS NOT NULL AND ro.receipt_time >= #{beginTime} AND ro.receipt_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY po.supplier_id, s.name ORDER BY receiptCount DESC

SELECT ro.id AS id, ro.order_no AS receiptNo, ro.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, po.order_no AS purchaseOrderNo, ro.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, ro.receipt_time AS receiptTime, ro.operator_name AS operatorName, ro.delivery_order_no AS deliveryOrderNo, ro.total_amount AS totalAmount, po.expect_date AS expectDate, CASE WHEN DATE(ro.receipt_time) <= po.expect_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS onTime FROM receipt_order ro JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = ro.purchase_order_id JOIN supplier s ON s.id = ro.supplier_id WHERE ORDER BY ro.receipt_time DESC, ro.id DESC
